parameters.name: boot_mode
parameters.constraint: norm, dd, ds, of or sms

parameters.name: include
parameters.constraint: subset of resources, rmc, profile_drift, refcodes

parameters.name: placement

parameters.constraint: an integer number of minutes, as documented; the tool types it bool and sends true or false

parameters.name: pci_class
parameters.constraint: one of eth, sas, san, nvme

parameters.name: lpar_state
parameters.constraint: Not Activated, or Running with active RMC

parameters.name: selector
parameters.constraint: adapter, physical port and unconfigured logical port

parameters.name: profile
parameters.constraint: lists exactly the selected logical port

parameters.name: backing
parameters.constraint: one SR-IOV backing device: VIOS, adapter, physical port, capacity

parameters.name: slot_num
parameters.constraint: vNIC slot with exactly one active, Operational backing
